skill.name: knowledge-work-sales
skill.description: Use when you need to prospect, craft personalized outreach, build deal strategy, manage pipeline, or prep for sales calls with research-backed context.
whenToUse: Researching a company or contact before a call, with news and hiring signals
Drafting research-first personalized outreach emails and LinkedIn messages
Reviewing pipeline health — prioritizing deals, flagging risks, building a weekly plan
Processing call notes into action items, follow-ups, and internal summaries

keyConcepts.explanation: Researches a company or person via web search — company intel, key contacts, recent news, and hiring signals — triggering automatically when you ask about a prospect.
Research-first outreach: researches the prospect, then drafts personalized email and LinkedIn messages with multiple angles.
/pipeline-review scores pipeline health and flags stale or single-threaded deals; /forecast produces a weighted forecast with best/likely/worst scenarios and gap analysis.
call-prep assembles account context, attendee research, agenda, and discovery questions; /call-summary turns notes or transcripts into action items and a draft follow-up.
Researches competitors for product comparison, pricing intel, recent releases, a differentiation matrix, and sales talk tracks.
Every workflow runs standalone from pasted notes, uploaded CSVs, or your description, and gets richer when CRM, email, and other MCP connectors are attached.

gotchas: Primarily designed for Cowork, Anthropic's agentic desktop app, though it also runs in Claude Code
Works standalone with web search and your input, but CRM/email connectors are needed to log activity or auto-create tasks
/forecast and /pipeline-review expect a CSV export or a described pipeline — no connector, no automatic data
account-research and draft-outreach fire automatically when relevant, so phrasing a request as prospect research triggers them
Outreach is research-first by design; skipping the research step defeats the personalization the plugin is built for
